title: A Ladder
intro: A ladder is a repeated chase: one player gives atari, and the other extends. Follow this chase toward the edge.

steps.instruction: White has two liberties. Give atari.
steps.hint: The end of the board is that way. Count how far.
steps.explanation: White has one liberty left. That is the point it can extend to.

steps.instruction: White has extended. Give atari again.
steps.hint: Same move as last time, one step along.
steps.explanation: The chase continues. Follow both players' moves before deciding whether to start a ladder.

steps.instruction: Give atari to the white group again.
steps.explanation: White is still in atari. The group has grown, but it has not escaped.

steps.instruction: Continue the chase toward the edge.
steps.hint: Keep going. The edge is close.
steps.explanation: The edge leaves White no more space to run. A friendly stone farther along the chase could change this result.

outro: Before starting a ladder, follow the chase to its end. Look for stones that could help the escaping group.
